approved: Digital ID (Transitional and Consequential Provisions) Bill 2023
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill handles transition and updates needed once the main Digital ID Act becomes law.
It would amend several existing Acts, including the Privacy Act and the Competition and Consumer Act, to support the new digital ID system.
The bill would start at the same time as the principal Act and would not take effect if that Act does not commence.

Amends the Administrative Decisions (Judicial Review) Act 1977, Age Discrimination Act 2004, Australian Security Intelligence Organisation Act 1979, Competition and Consumer Act 2010, Privacy Act 1988, and Taxation Administration Act 1953.
Provides for transitional arrangements arising from the principal Bill.
Sets commencement tied to the principal Bill's commencement.
The Commonwealth, state and territory governments, eventually the private sector, and entities providing digital ID services.

The majority voted in favour of government amendments on [sheet UP109](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fs1404_amend_9f9593f9-b0e2-4c2b-85ab-3caf7f3673cb%22;rec=0), which means they will now be incorporated into the bill. The amendments related to law enforcement reporting, deactivation, privacy, testing, phasing-in, destruction of information and a fees review. ### What do these amendments do? The Government provided a [supplementary explanatory memorandum](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Fems%2Fs1404_ems_bea16aaa-9e69-4e6d-9121-ae585f9f35e1%22;rec=0) to explain what these amendments do.

The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fs1404_amend_28edf29e-a187-4818-b267-dc429528a4fa%22;rec=0) that clause 60 of the Digital ID Bill 2023 stand as printed.
